blur=cv2.GaussianBlur(tex,(0,0),2)

cy,cx=488.,679.
dx=xx-cx;dy=yy-cy

            col=color[None,None,:]*(.91+.12*np.clip(1-dist,0,1)[:,:,None])
            out[y1:y2,x1:x2]=out[y1:y2,x1:x2]*(1-a[:,:,None])+col*a[:,:,None]
    frames[i]=np.clip(out,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    if i%24==0: print('Rendered',i,'/',N,flush=True)
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
print('Saved 120 RGB frames.',flush=True)
